content: Paul cawh apostol sahlo tah aa cyhlang
Kung hrawhluipali khy tah Barnaba khatah Jerusalem lang ka kechy kaw. Tita zong ka chui pai hrah.

Apalynah ka hmuhpaw hratah ka seipaw cang ka, Gental cawngsaw sahlo khatah ka reipaw thawngchawbia khah ka chingpase he. Canghrasala, ma ka rei paselaipaw heh aa hotu sahlo hai letah long a cang, zecawtamaw tatah hninglang letei ka za hre ciapaw rai cang seh, atohei ka hre lepaw rai cang seh, a longpaw tah cangsah du bei neh.
Kama khatei a seihrahpaw Tita hmai khah Grik cawngsaw a cang thlang naná teitah ahotahmai tah cingpatai siachai bei he.
Zemaw ma kong heh a chua tahpaw co, Khri Zisu letei kaa hnuipaw zalongnah khah lah pah hly pawtah le kaaning khah cingpatainah sae tah tua pawtah uny pakheipaw sahlo cawh kaa hrong letah a va nae he.
Kaaning taco aa reipaw khah sungkheh tei hmai nge pah bei peh, zecawtamaw tatah naaning letah ahmangpaw thawngchawbia cawh a ung paria thlang nápaw cawtah a cang.
Mehpuimaw aa tahpaw he sahlo tah ka reipaw bia letah zehmai chahchi bei he. Aho a cang zong tah ka cawtah zehmai a cangpaw hlui be. Khazing tah alailang hmuisang ming tah bia pace be.

Piter cawh Juda cawngsaw khatah thawngchawbia rei rua pawtah Khazing tah a thingpaw hratah kama zong Gental cawngsaw khatah thawngchawbia rei rua pawtah rai a pa khingpaw heh aaning sahlo tah aa hni thlang.
Juda cawngsaw khatah apostol a cangpaw Piter a rai hrenah letei rai a hrepaw Khazing tah Gental cawngsaw khatah apostol a cangpaw kama ka rai hrenah letah zong rai a hre hrah.

Hotu cai a cangpaw he Jeims le Piter le Johan tah kama letei pehpaw Khazing ningdonah khah aa hmuh tihtah aa ma chyhlangpaw palangnah tah Barnaba le kama cawh kaa kih aa ma tle. Gental cawngsaw sahlo khatah kaaning sei pawtah le Juda cawngsaw sahlo khatah aaning sei pawtah khei aa naw a tlah.
Hming sangkheh aa ma chingpaw cawh mehsisah bawkhang khah a thui paria thlangpaw khah cang ka, ma cawh kama zong tah tua ka du caipaw khah a cang.
Paul tah Piter a mochia
Piter cawh Antiok khuapui lang a va tlong ning tah ahmangpaw tah hming a tualynah cawtah hmedai teitah ka mochia.

A va phah hmasaw taw ning tah Gental cawngsaw sahlo khatah batui a e hrui. Canghrasala, Jeims tah a thlawpaw he Juda cawngsaw thaikhehpaw aa va chua tihtah e du khawh lytah Gental cawngsaw taitah a patlia kaw, zecawtamaw tatah cingpatai a hy aa tahpaw Juda sahlo khah a cinah caw he tah a cang.

Ma hraco Piter tah a tua cawtah a hringpaw Juda cawngsaw sahlo zong tah Juda cawngsaw a cang lypaw zingtu sahlo khakhei batui e hrui ngang khawh bei he. Aaning sahlo aa hringzia ahmang lypaw taco Barnaba zong hruipahrih hrah ka, aaning sahlo aa tuapaw hrakhei a tua hrah.

Ma sahlo tahei biahmuisui thawngchawbia heh zui khawh bei he tah ka hmuh tihtah aa zawpui hme letah Piter cawh, “Nama cawh Juda cawngsaw na cang thlang naná teitah Juda cawngsaw hratah ung ly ceh tah Gental cawngsaw hratah na ung. Ma heh zekhatamaw a cang, Gental cawngsaw sahlo khah Juda phung naa zui a tatah na tah zia he?
Kaaning sahlo cawh Juda no le paw tah sahpaw cang he peh ka, Gental cawngsaw sahlo hratah mehsua tatah tah cang bei peh.

Cawngsaw cawh phungbia zuinah thongtah cang lytah Zisu Khri letei zingnah thongtah Khazing tah thai a cangsah tahpaw cawh kaa hni. Macawtaco, Khri letei angepainah thongtah mehding tah cyhlang kaa cang nápawtah kaaning zong Khri Zisu letah zingnah kaa chiapaw a cang. Phung zuinah thongtah cang a be, zecawtamaw tatah phung zuinah thongtah ahohmai thaicangsah cang bei he takhah kaa hni.

Khri letah mehding tah cyhlang pawtah kaa pachia chung tahei peh, kaaning cawh mehsua ka cang thlangpaw tei a cang caco, Khri cawh sua tuanah letah thaw a peh hrah tahnah a cang maw? Cang hrahring be.
A cang naná tah ka hlawh ciapaw phunglang khah ka zui kaw caco, kama cawh phunglang a rawhtu ka cang tahnah a cang.
Khazing cawtah ka hring khy nápawtah ka cawtah thihnah a cangpaw phungbia taikhei ka thi myca.

Kama cawh Khri khatah khaipai cang myca neh ka, hring khawh bei neh. A cang naná teitah Khri cawh ka chung letah a hring myca. Pungsaw tei ka hringpaw hringnah heh pa do katei ka cawtah a hringnah a peipaw Khazing Sawcapaw ka zingnah rawng tah ka hringpaw a cang.
Khazing ningdonah cawh ze lypaw tah tua bei neh, zemaw tah pawco, dingnah cawh phungbia thongtah hmuh khy a cang caco, Khri thihnah cawh ze lypaw a cang a,” tatah ka tah.
